one_line: Vegetation greening in a wet 2026 season: a 12-pixel bbox cut from a ragged SW-NE green swath; siblings 172 m and 306 m away already closed the same way.
summary: before.png and after.png show the same mottled shrub-on-bare-soil plateau inside the 115 x 54 m box in both years, with no new object, edge or bright surface; hires.png (Esri, 2025-05-30, pre-onset) and all six wayback_strip.png releases from 2014 to 2026 show only shrub clumps and faint old tracks, nothing built. falsecolor_after.png shows a ragged, lobate green band several hundred metres long running SW-NE through the box, absent in falsecolor_before.png, and difference.png shows the NDVI rise spanning that whole swath while the brightness panel is near zero at the box. timeseries.png shows inside and ring tracking identically through 2024-2025, a joint snow spike on 2026-01-03, and then the footprint staying slightly greener (inside-minus-ring NDVI +0.017 to +0.032, NBR +0.04 to +0.06) through 2026 while brightness contrast is unchanged within 0.01. The panel concluded unanimously (3 of 3 refuted, high confidence) that this is interannual greening of sparse shrub-steppe in a shallow hollow during a wetter 2026, the same regional response that produced eight sibling candidates across 37 km, including OC0011 at 172 m and OC0007 at 306 m with the identical onset window, both already closed as natural:regional_pattern. OC0014 escaped that rule only because its 4,800 m2 area is exactly 12 pixels at 20 m and the shape metrics (4 corners, rectangularity 0.8) describe the bounding box rather than any shape seen in an image; the Landsat confirmation is the same NBR greening measured twice (0.053 vs 0.054), not independent evidence of an installation.
explanation: Natural vegetation greening (regional wet-year response, 2026) of sparse shrub-steppe on the Ustyurt plateau, locally stronger along a shallow drainage hollow; the footprint is a bounding-box fragment of a continuous SW-NE greening swath. The spectral signature (d_ndvi +0.106, d_nbr +0.158, d_brightness -0.022, d_swir -0.039, zero brightness contrast change against the ring) is vegetation, not construction, and no structure, pad, pit or new track appears in hires.png or any Wayback release.
next_step: Any sub-metre image acquired after May 2026 (next Esri/Maxar refresh) of 43.4454 N 56.1979 E showing only denser shrub/grass in the footprint would close it outright; without new imagery, re-run the natural:regional_pattern check with the regular-outline exception disabled for blobs under ~20 detection pixels (or with the shape computed from the change mask instead of its bbox), merging OC0007, OC0011 and OC0014 into one footprint, and check the July 2027 Sentinel-2 composite: a shrinking inside-minus-ring NDVI excess in a drier year confirms vegetation.
